title: AI Developer
description:
**AI Developer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years of professional software engineering, including at least one LLM-based feature shipped to production
* **Programming:** Strong TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable writing SQL
* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Image-generation APIs, vector search (pgvector), job queues (Redis, BullMQ), Next.js and React, three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, German language

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1748816

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer**

  

**The opportunity**

In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology we are looking for an innovative AI-Native DevSecOps Developer to rapidly design, build and ship custom software products that automate, orchestrate and modernize EY's infrastructure platform engineering capabilities. This is not a traditional software engineering role — it is a product builder position for someone who uses AI as their primary development accelerator and who thrives on shipping working software quickly.

The successful candidate will lead the end-to-end delivery of AI-native internal products — self-service infrastructure portals, workflow orchestration engines, policy-as-code enforcement systems and operational automation platforms — built on modern cloud-native stacks including Kubernetes, Temporal, Terraform and Angular. They will have sufficient infrastructure awareness to understand the operational context of what they are building, and will work closely with I&O engineering teams to translate complex infrastructure workflows into elegant, automated, AI-augmented software solutions.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

The I&O Platform Infrastructure AI-Native DevSecOps Developer designs and delivers bespoke internal software products that eliminate manual infrastructure workflows, accelerate provisioning and give engineers and stakeholders real-time, self-service operational visibility. Drawing on AI coding tools as a core development accelerant, this professional dramatically compresses delivery timelines — prototyping, iterating and shipping production-grade software at a pace that traditional development workflows cannot match.

The role spans the full software development lifecycle — from requirements and architecture through build, test, security hardening, deployment and ongoing improvement — with a security-first mindset embedded at every stage. The developer will own the product delivery end-to-end, partnering with I&O platform engineers, architects and service management stakeholders to ensure what is built reflects the real operational needs of the infrastructure estate and is designed to scale across EY's global data center footprint.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Demonstrated ability to build and ship production-grade software rapidly using AI development tools as a primary delivery accelerant (exclusionary).
* Deep, active use of AI coding assistants throughout the development lifecycle, including:
  + GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI pair-programming tools
  + ChatGPT, Claude or similar LLMs for architecture design, code generation and review
  + AI-assisted test generation, security scanning and code refactoring
  + Prompt engineering for development workflow automation
* Strong full-stack development capability across front-end and back-end disciplines:
  + Angular (v14+) for self-service portal and operational UI development
  + Python or Go for back-end services, APIs and automation engines
  + REST and GraphQL API design and implementation
* Hands-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms, particularly Temporal.io.
* Strong Kubernetes engineering skills — deployment, Helm charts, operators, RBAC and namespace management.
* Infrastructure-as-Code authoring using Terraform and Ansible for provisioning automation.
* Strong DevSecOps pipeline development — CI/CD design, security gate integration and automated deployment:
  + GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps pipelines
  + SAST/DAST tooling integration (Snyk, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
  + Container image scanning and policy enforcement (Trivy, Cosign, OPA/Gatekeeper)
* Policy-as-Code implementation using Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent.
* Experience building AI-native product features, including:
  + LLM integration via API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic or equivalent)
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns for operational knowledge bases
  + AI-driven workflow decision making and self-healing automation
  + Copilot / chat interface integration into operational tooling
* Sufficient infrastructure platform knowledge to design software that reflects real-world operational constraints:
  + Virtualization and hyperconverged infrastructure concepts (Nutanix, Hyper-V, VMware)
  + Windows Server and Linux operating system fundamentals
  + Networking concepts — VLANs, DNS, IP management, load balancing
  + Storage and compute provisioning workflows
  + ServiceNow ITSM integration patterns
* Strong software product ownership mindset — able to take a problem statement from whiteboard to production with minimal hand-holding.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to demo working software and articulate product decisions to both technical and executive audiences.
* Strong working knowledge of Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**

* Full-stack software product development and delivery — 5–7 years.
* AI-assisted software development as an active daily workflow — 2+ years.
* Angular front-end application development (v14+) — 3–5 years.
* Python or Go back-end service development — 5+ years.
* Kubernetes cluster management and application deployment — 3–5 years.
* Terraform and Ansible Infrastructure-as-Code authoring — 3–5 years.
* Temporal.io or equivalent workflow orchestration platform (Argo, Conductor or equivalent).
* CI/CD pipeline development with integrated security gates — 3–5 years.
* LLM API integration for production AI-native product features.
* Open Policy Agent (OPA) or equivalent policy-as-code enforcement.
* REST API design, development and documentation.
* Container build, scanning and secure image management (Docker, Podman).
* Git-based source control and pull-request-driven development workflows (GitHub, Azure DevOps).
* SAST/DAST security tooling integration in CI pipelines.
* ITSM platform integration — ServiceNow API or equivalent.
* Agile sprint-based delivery with regular demo and release cadences.
* Infrastructure provisioning workflow automation (VM builds, network configuration, DNS/IP management).
* Helm chart authoring for Kubernetes application packaging and deployment.

  

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Microsoft Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204) or equivalent cloud certification (desired).
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) or CKA certification (better to have).
* HashiCorp Terraform Associate certification (desired).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience building on or integrating with Nutanix platform APIs (NCM, Prism, Calm).
* Experience with Temporal Cloud or self-hosted Temporal cluster operations.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure AI Studio for enterprise AI product development.
* Familiarity with GitOps patterns using ArgoCD or Flux for continuous deployment.
* Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source infrastructure automation projects.

  

**What we look for**

A builder — someone who moves fast, thinks in systems and ships working software that solves real infrastructure problems. We are looking for an individual who genuinely uses AI as a development superpower, who understands enough about infrastructure to design software that works in the real world, and who takes pride in owning a product end-to-end from first commit to production. The ideal candidate has already built something like HCSP — a platform that replaces manual, multi-portal, error-prone operational workflows with a single automated, observable, self-healing system — and is ready to do it again at EY scale.

  

**What we offer**

We offer a competitive remuneration package where you'll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development. Plus, we offer:

* **Continuous learning:** You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
About the Role

Elkanio is hiring a **Senior Python Developer** to join an established engineering team working on a prestigious **B2C travel experience booking platform**. The product is live, has real users, and is scaling — we're expanding the team to accelerate the roadmap, strengthen delivery, and evolve the platform further.

You'll be plugging into an existing codebase and a working engineering team, contributing to new features, performance improvements, architectural enhancements, and platform evolution. This is a role for someone who's comfortable navigating mature systems, picking up context quickly, making sound technical decisions, and adding value from week one.

Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to take ownership of technical solutions, participate in system and architectural design, identify areas for improvement, and help the team build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software.

What You'll Do

* Build new features and enhance existing ones across the stack, with **Python/Django** as the primary backend technology.
* Work within an established production codebase: understand it carefully, respect existing patterns, and improve it thoughtfully.
* Design and extend **scalable RESTful APIs** powering booking flows, search, payments, user journeys, and other core platform capabilities.
* Translate business and product requirements into robust technical solutions, defining components, APIs, data flows, and integration approaches.
* Participate actively in **system design and architectural decisions**, considering scalability, performance, security, reliability, maintainability, and delivery timelines.
* Own technical solutions for assigned modules or business domains from **requirement analysis and design through implementation, deployment, and production support**.
* Review existing architecture and identify opportunities to simplify, modernize, and improve system reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Design solutions for high\-volume search, booking, payment, and transaction workflows, with appropriate handling of concurrency, failures, retries, and data consistency.
* Design and optimize database models, queries, indexing strategies, caching approaches, and data\-access patterns to support application performance and scale.
* Integrate and maintain third\-party services including **payment gateways, mapping services, communication platforms, and travel\-domain APIs**.
* Design resilient third\-party integrations with appropriate timeout handling, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and failure recovery.
* Identify and address **performance bottlenecks, technical debt, architectural limitations, and scalability concerns** as the platform grows.
* Collaborate with the client's product, design, and engineering teams on planning, technical discussions, design reviews, and releases.
* Participate in code reviews and technical design reviews, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to engineering standards.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other developers and contribute to improving team engineering practices.
* Debug and resolve production issues with ownership and urgency, while identifying and addressing underlying technical causes.
* Communicate technical approaches, trade\-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

What We're Looking For

* **4–8 years of hands\-on software development experience**, with significant experience building production\-grade backend applications.
* Strong backend expertise in **Python**, with solid hands\-on experience in frameworks such as **Django**.
* Strong understanding of **software architecture and system design**, with the ability to design scalable backend solutions from business requirements.
* Proven experience designing and implementing **RESTful APIs and backend services** in production environments.
* Strong understanding of architectural and engineering principles such as **SOLID, separation of concerns, modularity, design patterns, and clean, maintainable code**.
* Ability to work effectively with and extend **existing production codebases**, rather than focusing only on greenfield development.
* Ability to make sound technical trade\-offs across **performance, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and delivery timelines**.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, API security, and general security best practices.
* Strong experience with relational databases, particularly **PostgreSQL**, including schema design, indexing, transactions, and query optimization.
* Working knowledge of **NoSQL databases such as MongoDB** and an understanding of when different data\-storage approaches are appropriate.
* Experience with caching, background processing, asynchronous workflows, queues, or similar approaches used in scalable applications.
* Experience identifying application and system bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve **performance and scalability**.
* Experience designing and working with third\-party integrations and external APIs.
* Proficiency with **Git** and collaborative software development workflows.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly **AWS**, and containerization technologies such as **Docker**.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, create implementation approaches, and communicate **technical designs and architectural decisions** clearly.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a client\-facing setup.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to mentor developers, participate in technical discussions, and provide constructive guidance through design and code reviews.

Senior\-Level Ownership

As a Senior Developer, you'll be expected to go beyond implementation and take ownership of the technical direction of the areas you work on.

* Own technical solutions for assigned modules or business domains.
* Act as a technical point of contact for complex backend, integration, and production issues.
* Evaluate existing implementations and recommend pragmatic architectural improvements.
* Challenge requirements constructively and propose technically sound alternatives where appropriate.
* Balance ideal engineering solutions with practical business and delivery constraints.
* Identify architectural risks and technical debt early and help establish practical remediation plans.
* Mentor other developers on coding practices, design approaches, debugging, and engineering best practices.
* Contribute to defining and maintaining coding standards, design patterns, and engineering practices across the team.

Bonus Points

* Prior experience working on **B2C platforms**, especially in travel, hospitality, e\-commerce, or other transaction\-heavy domains.
* Experience contributing to **mature, production\-scale systems** with real users and high availability requirements.
* Experience with **payment gateways and third\-party booking/inventory APIs**.
* Experience with travel\-domain APIs, flight/hotel booking platforms, GDS/NDC, OTA, or other travel technology integrations.
* Experience with distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, message queues, or asynchronous processing.
* Experience with application monitoring, logging, observability, and production performance analysis.
* Experience creating **architecture diagrams, technical design documents, API contracts, or solution designs**.

What We Offer

* Compensation aligned with your experience and the industry standard — we don't underpay good people.
* The opportunity to work on a **marquee B2C travel product with real users and real\-world impact**.
* A collaborative, low\-ego engineering environment where ideas and technical discussions are encouraged.
* Direct exposure to **client stakeholders, product teams, and technical decision\-making**.
* The opportunity to work on challenging problems involving **scale, integrations, performance, payments, and travel technology**.
* Room to grow technically, take ownership of larger areas, and contribute to the evolution of the platform.
* An environment where senior engineers can influence **architecture, engineering practices, and product evolution**, rather than simply implementing assigned tasks.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

* Python: 4 years (Preferred)
